review.defects: Rejected: the model added a per-team table '團隊平均處理時數' with A 34, B 45, C 6. 34 and 45 are A's and B's resolved counts and 6 is A's hours; none is a team's hours. Every row cites E1, the table_inspect sample, which does contain those numbers but in other columns, so the citations exist while pointing at the wrong field. The completion reply repeats the wrong per-team figures.
review.task_design_note: The task text '各團隊的平均處理時數（hours 欄的平均）' was intended as the overall mean of the hours column but can be read as a per-team listing. That ambiguity is a flaw in this unseen task's wording; it does not excuse the wrong numbers, which are wrong under either reading.
review.harness_note: Automatic checks passed because every expected value appears in the body. No verifier checks that a number cited to inspection evidence sits in the column its label names; that would need the label-to-column meaning and was not added.
